forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO (Judge ruling Day 222). Neither YES condition satisfied. Condition A: coalition held one-seat majority (61 seats) through dissolution per prior adjudication v48.0 (TIER1: Al Jazeera, Times of Israel 2026-07-17); pre-dissolution polling at 48 seats is an electoral projection, not a formal Knesset roll-call vote confirming majority loss. Condition B: dissolution occurred at natural end of four-year term per prior TIER1-cited adjudication ('Dissolve early = NO'); furthermore, election date Oct 27 equals forecast horizon exactly — condition B requires election date EARLIER THAN 2026-10-27, and equal does not satisfy that requirement. Source A RESOLVE-YES rejected. Human review flag: even if November 2026 is the statutory term expiry, condition B's 'earlier than Oct 27' date sub-requirement still fails.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?

No named Iranian official issued a public statement committing to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations before EOD September 6, 2026. Pezeshkian attended SCO summit Sep 1 and met Putin — no ceasefire commitment issued. Trump extended limited ceasefire Sep 5 (US action, not Iranian commitment).
